name: Standing Outside a Broken Phone Booth with Money in My Hand

info.album: Standing outside a broken phone booth with money in my hand

podcast.body: Primitive Radio Gods scored a hit with their song "Standing Outside a Broken Phone Booth with Money in My Hand" from *The Cable Guy* soundtrack in 1996. This soundtrack was associated with the "creepy Jim Carrey vehicle" film and also featured contributions from artists like Silverchair and Jerry Cantrell. "Primitive radio gods ended up with a hit with standing outside a broken phone booth with money in my hand."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track was a piano-based demo created by Chris O'Connor, featuring a sample of B.B. King singing "How Blue Can You Get." After being picked up by Fiction Records, it first appeared on the soundtrack for the Jim Carrey movie *Cable Guy* in 1996, where it tested well with audiences. Its success led to the commissioning of the album *Rocket*, which sold half a million copies. "It was a piano track featuring a sampled BB King singing a song called How Blue Can You Get."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
